nodes.rationale: __init__.py, wf.py, wfcommon.py, dashboard/ — stdlib-only Python under ~/.hermes/plugins/hermes-workflows/.

nodes.label: Child Spawn Contract (hermes chat -Q)
nodes.rationale: Children spawned as hermes chat --query-file … -Q --max-turns N — stock quiet one-shot CLI contract; no patched Hermes required.

nodes.label: Cooperative Steer
nodes.rationale: steer queues text; running child pulls at next seam via inbox action; does not interrupt mid-turn; baked per-spawn with high-water mark.

nodes.label: DAG of Agent Nodes
nodes.rationale: Core abstraction: a JSON graph of agent nodes, fan-outs, and gates executed as a background process owned by the calling session.

nodes.label: Desktop DAG View
nodes.rationale: Desktop half (plugin.js) renders live graph, fan-out stacks, timeline, gate hand-off, and ::workflow card; SDK surface only.

nodes.label: Desktop Half (plugin.js)
nodes.rationale: Plain ESM on Hermes Desktop plugin SDK surface only; lives under ~/.hermes/desktop-plugins/hermes-workflows/.

nodes.label: Fan-out
nodes.rationale: One node spawns N live children from fanout.items or items_from; quorum defaults to majority; stragglers cancelled at quorum.

nodes.label: Fingerprint Replay-Skip Resume
nodes.rationale: Every finished node records an effective fingerprint; crash, restart, or amend only re-runs what actually changed.

nodes.label: Human and Machine Gates
nodes.rationale: Human gates hold until release; machine gates use wait_s or until_argv; when predicates branch; on_skip:prune kills losing arm.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: 1003 nodes / 1946 edges over every function, class, test, doc heading; deterministic tree-sitter parsing, no LLM in build; CI fails on drift.

nodes.label: Hermes Agent (Host Platform)
nodes.rationale: Host platform providing the plugin system, CLI (hermes chat --query-file -Q --max-turns), quiet turn report, and desktop SDK.

nodes.label: Quiet Turn Report (HERMES_QUIET_TURN_REPORT_FILE)
nodes.rationale: Per-spawn file written by child, read then unlinked by runner; stock writes {pid, exit_code, error, reply}; patch adds turn_exit_reason.

nodes.label: Transcript Directives (::name{attrs})
nodes.rationale: Contribution area where plugins register named directives; model emits ::name{key="value"} and plugin component renders inline.

nodes.label: Typed Failure Events (error_class)
nodes.rationale: Closed set of error_class values on every node.failed; parent reads facts not prose; cancelled is never a failure; partial is harvestable.

nodes.label: workflow Tool
nodes.rationale: Single tool registered by the plugin; actions: run, status, wait, release, steer, inbox, amend, stop, list, save, library.

nodes.label: docs/catalog/entry.yaml — Catalog Entry
nodes.rationale: Pins a full 40-char commit SHA for the catalog; capabilities block is metadata-only for listing, not enforcement.

nodes.label: TranscriptDirectiveLeaf (React Component)
nodes.rationale: Renders plugin component for every claimed ::name{...} in text; registry-backed resolution; stable component identity per (render, parsed).

nodes.label: TRANSCRIPT_DIRECTIVE_AREA
nodes.rationale: Contribution area identifier 'transcript.directives'; plugins register into it; exported from SDK index.

nodes.label: parseTranscriptDirective()
nodes.rationale: Parses entire paragraph as one directive; returns null unless trimmed text is exactly ::name{attrs}; pure and synchronous.

nodes.label: segmentTranscriptDirectives()
nodes.rationale: Splits paragraph into prose runs and embedded directives in order; used when onboarding flag is enabled.

nodes.label: tests/fixtures/mac-source.txt — Transcript Directives Fixture
nodes.rationale: Contains the upstream Hermes Desktop transcript-directives parser, renderer, and contribution registration as a test fixture for the desktop plugin's card rendering.
